messages:
Maria R.: heads up: deploy-bot scheduled the v3.2.1 rollout for 22:00 UTC across api/runtime/console/router. change window 2h. tagging SRE + product: @Sam (oncall) @Kevin L.
deploy-bot: Scheduled rollout v3.2.1 -> targets: runtime:3.2.1, router:3.2.1, console:3.2.1. Wave: canary 1% -> 10% -> 100%. Start: 7087654321. /deploy status
Kevin L.: quick FYI from staging: console 3.2.1 added required header x-route-v in the new telemetry shim. router 3.2.1 emits x-route-v only when header-swap flag is set. mismatch on by-default behavior.
Jess P.: oof. did we run the console compatibility testset? //cc @release-bot
Kevin L.: yes, but test harness used mock router that included the header. real router default didn't. Missed in integration.
Sam (oncall): we should either toggle router flag in canary or pin router at 3.2.0 for the rollout. Pin is safer for immediate window.
Maria R.: rolling back the pin decision would require a follow-up patch + hotfix checklist. timeline?
Jess P.: pin router ->3.2.0 at deploy config, proceed with runtime+console canary? runtime change is independent. console needs header, but can detect header and no-op if absent? not yet in prod.
Sam (oncall): prefer pin router. That avoids client-visible errors. We can schedule a follow-up to sync router flag behavior in next sprint. Also notify customers on breaking change.
Kevin L.: agreed. will update deploy config. small note: need router owners to ack because they'd be downgraded for this wave.
deploy-bot: Pending change: router -> pinned to 3.2.0 for wave. Waiting approvals from router-owners and release lead. Approvals: none.
Jess P.: @Sam can you ping router-owners for immediate +1? also add release note: "console v3.2.1 adds telemetry header; router flag gating to be aligned in v3.2.2". Keep it short.
Sam (oncall): pinged in #eng-router: "urgent: approve temporary pin to 3.2.0 for release window due to console header mismatch" :eyes:
router-owner (via thread): +1 from me, agree with pin. will follow up for flag alignment.
release-bot: Approval recorded: router-owner1 (+1) at 7087654333. Release lead pending.
Maria R.: @release-bot please hold deploy to canary until we have release lead signoff. Updating release notes and deps in PR.
release-bot: Release lead (@Kevin L.) approved at 7087654340. deploy-bot: proceeding to start canary for runtime and console with router pinned.
deploy-bot: Starting canary: runtime -> 1%, console -> 1%, router pinned 3.2.0. Logs: ```[canary] runtime: ok
[canary] console: warn: missing-header-handling=false
[canary] router: pinned at 3.2.0
``` 
Kevin L.: seeing a small spike in console errors related to telemetry parsing, but they are non-fatal. Monitoring closely.
Maria R.: hold on full rollout until metrics stable for 15m. If error rate >1.5% will abort and rollback.
Sam (oncall): metric check at +10m: error rate 0.6% and trending down. ok to proceed to 10%.
deploy-bot: progressing to 10%: runtime 10%, console 10%, router pinned 3.2.0. Logs: ```[10%] runtime: ok
[10%] console: warn reduced
``` 
Kevin L.: metrics look good. I'm updating post-deploy note: pin will be documented and removed in v3.2.2 with router flag flip.
Maria R.: final step: rolling to 100% in 30m if stable. Action items: (1) engineering to track router flag work (owner: router-owner1), (2) update public release notes to mention temporary pin (owner: Jess P.), (3) create follow-up ticket to lift pin (owner: Kevin L.).
Sam (oncall): noted. I'm leaving a rollback playbook in runbook: if console errors >2% within next 30m -> manual rollback of console to 3.2.0. Deploybot will assist.
release-bot: Release completed to 100% with router pinned. Summary: successful canary -> full. Postmortem: schedule in next retro to cover test harness gap.
Maria R.: thanks all. I'll draft a short postmortem and link the follow-up tickets.
Kevin L.: thanks, team :thumbsup:
Jess P.: nice catch everyone. :party:
deploy-bot: thread closed by release-bot at 7087654350."
